items.exampleEn: I practice the piano every day.
He plays the guitar in a band.
He has a new baseball bat.
There is a music festival in the park.

items.sentenceEn: I play the piano, and my sister plays the guitar.
items.sentenceZh: 我彈鋼琴，我妹妹彈吉他。

items.audioEn: There is a music contest at the festival this weekend.
items.audioZh: 這個週末的慶典上有一場音樂比賽。
items.questionZh: 這個週末的慶典上有什麼？

items.sentenceEn: My little brother is afraid of ghosts.
Bring your bat to the baseball game.
items.sentenceZh: 帶你的球棒去棒球比賽。

items.stemEn: I play ____ with my friends on the weekend.

items.passageEn: Every year, our town has a music festival. Many musicians come. Some play the guitar, and some play the piano. There is also a contest for young singers. When it gets dark, my grandpa tells ghost stories. It is my favorite festival.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上每年都有音樂節，很多音樂家都會來，有的彈吉他，有的彈鋼琴。還有一場給年輕歌手的比賽。天黑以後，我爺爺會講鬼故事。這是我最喜歡的節慶。

referenceEn: I practice the guitar every day.
I practice playing the guitar every day.
rubricZh: 樂器前常加 the（例如 the guitar）
「練習彈吉他」可寫 practice the guitar、practice playing the guitar 等

items.instructionZh: 用 festival 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的節日或慶典。
referenceEn: My favorite festival is Chinese New Year.
There is a big music festival in my city.
rubricZh: festival 前面可加 a、the 或所有格（例如 a music festival）
